basics.name: Ayush Shukla
basics.label: Development Finance & Impact Investing
basics.summary: Development finance professional with 7+ years across impact investing, government, and international development organizations. Currently a Research Associate at the International Finance Corporation (World Bank Group). Harvard MPA/ID graduate working on blended finance, financial inclusion, and data-driven policy, with a focus on South and Southeast Asia.

work.name: International Finance Corporation (World Bank Group)
highlights: Supporting IFC investment-thesis development on the silver economy (aging-population markets) in East Asia Pacific.

work.name: DIME AI, World Bank Group
highlights: Drafted fundraising proposals and managed AI tool evaluations and external partner relationships.
Coordinated the ImpactAI launch event at the World Bank Annual Meetings and led the subsequent public release strategy.

work.name: AVPN
highlights: Built and executed AVPN's market-entry strategy into blended finance, including internal training materials.
Liaised with the World Bank, IFC, DFC, MCC, and USAID for an AVPN-managed blended finance fund facility.

work.name: Village Capital
highlights: Led $1M in equity investments across three financial inclusion companies; sourced 50+ companies, ran due diligence, and built investment theses.
Forged partnerships with five organizations for female-led accelerator programs in Afghanistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

work.name: Village Capital
highlights: Managed five accelerator programs for 50+ startups across South and Southeast Asia; sourced 500+ companies and prepared evaluation briefs.
Built and managed a network of 200+ founders, investors, and sector experts to catalyze venture funding in the region.
Drafted an Asia-wide migration report and an internal DEI regional action plan.

work.name: Government of Maharashtra
highlights: Facilitated $4M in donations to government hospitals for COVID-19 relief through national foundations and corporations.
Drafted the monitoring-and-review section of the Maharashtra State Startup Policy 2020.
Led a partnership with Udhyam Foundation to embed entrepreneurial thinking in the curriculum for 140,000 students annually.
Built daily hospital data dashboards and recommendation reports to support the state's pandemic response.

work.name: riidl (Research Innovation Incubation Design Labs)
highlights: Designed and launched the Startup School India course and ran design-thinking workshops for aspiring entrepreneurs.
Planned and led an immersion trek to innovation and incubation centers in China.

education.studyType: Master in Public Administration in International Development (MPA/ID)

Thesis: Leveraging and Scaling Diaspora Philanthropy for India's Development (Honorable Mention)
